rev.t: Decent marriage hall which can accommodate around 300 guests. Dining hall in the basement and can accommodate around 200 persons at a time. 17 rooms are there for guests. Lift facility available. Toilet management needs improvement. Parking …

A well appointed marriage hall with good amenities for conducting marriage functions.  The main hall can accommodate easily 400 people and dining hall accommodates around 300 people. There are 15 rooms for staying and rooms are good.

Ambience is good with all the facilities. It's more of like a movie theater kind of hall.
Food is average at best. Rooms are clean with geysers. No AC in any rooms. Washrooms at dining hall is horrible, they stopped cleaning them since ages.
